cosmos-video-reasoning-v1.0/reasoning.sc.title: cosmos-video-reasoning-v1.0 annotation file
cosmos-video-reasoning-v1.0/reasoning.sc.description: A single cosmos-video-reasoning-v1.0 annotation file. The file contains a flat list of training items. metadata.type is the schema discriminator (always 'annotation'); metadata.task is an optional free-form label (typically the task name when produced by the metropolis-v3.0 converter). question, answer, and reasoning are free-form strings — the format does not impose per-task structure.

type.description: Schema discriminator. Always 'annotation' for cosmos-video-reasoning-v1.0 annotation files.

task.description: Optional free-form label for the items in this file. Encouraged to be meaningful — the metropolis-v3.0 converter writes the source task name here (e.g. 'bcq', 'mcq', 'open_qa').

media_root.description: Root for resolving each item's video_id / image_id. null → resolve relative to the dataset root. A relative string → resolved as a subdirectory under the dataset root. An absolute path → used as-is (useful for shared media stores).

video_id.description: Path to the video file relative to media_root (or to the dataset root if media_root is null).

image_id.description: Path to the image file relative to media_root (or to the dataset root if media_root is null).

question.description: Free-form prompt presented to the model. May embed task-specific framing (multiple-choice options, format instructions, etc.) directly.

cosmos-reason-v1.0/conversation.schema.j.description: Single training sample conversation for Cosmos Reason v1.0. Contains alternating user/assistant turns with optional system preamble. Media references use positional placeholders (image_0, video_0) resolved via meta.json.

metropolis-v3.0/tasks/causal_linkage.sch.description: Causal reasoning task for videos: given two timestamps t1 and t2, explain the causal relationship between the event observed at t1 and the resulting situation at t2.

items.question: Explain the relationship between the event at 00:00:01 and the situation at 00:00:07.
items.answer: At 00:00:01, a dark pickup truck enters the intersection from the right to initiate a left-hand turn, while at 00:00:07, a silver sedan has come to a complete halt in the center of the intersection, facing the opposite direction of its original travel. The relationship between these two moments is a direct causal link resulting from a failure to yield right-of-way.
items.reasoning: The video begins by establishing a baseline of normal traffic flow at a busy intersection. At 00:00:01, several vehicles including a white utility van and a tan minivan are stopped at a red light...

metadata.description: Causal linkage between traffic events and resulting situations in anomalous ITS videos

Simultaneously, a dark pickup truck is struck by a FedEx truck.
